payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Move the source mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The mug present in the source image has been relocated to the right of the headphones. Do not count a newly introduced or duplicated mug on the right as fulfillment unless it is identifiable as the source mug itself.
outcome.reference: Compare the source mug and headphones with their corresponding objects in the edited image, using visual identity and position evidence without assuming correspondence when uncertain.

check.question: Comparing the source and edited images, has the source mug itself moved toward or to the right of the headphones, rather than merely being duplicated or replaced?
check.complete_when: The source mug is identifiable in the edited image and has been moved from its source position to a position clearly to the right of the headphones.
check.partial_when: The source mug is identifiable and has visibly moved toward the right relative to the headphones, but has not reached a position clearly to their right.
check.absent_when: The source mug remains in its original relative position to the headphones, or the only mug on the right is a separate newly introduced mug and the source mug has not moved toward the right.
check.unknown_when: There is genuinely insufficient visual evidence to identify the source mug's corresponding edited object or assess its movement and position.

dependencies.evidence: The source mug is a light-blue mug with its handle on the left, and the source headphones are black over-ear headphones. In the edit, the headphones remain identifiable, but there are two mugs: a small white mug beside/overlapping the headphones and a white mug to their right. Neither clearly matches the source mug’s blue color and appearance, so the source mug’s correspondence and movement cannot be confidently established; the right-side mug alone is not evidence that the source mug was moved.

response.content: {"status":"absent","evidence":"The source light-blue mug is no longer identifiable as a mug in the edit; only a blue blur remains at its original left-side location. The two visible white mugs do not match the source mug, so the mug on the headphones’ right does not show that the source mug moved."}

parsed.evidence: The source light-blue mug is no longer identifiable as a mug in the edit; only a blue blur remains at its original left-side location. The two visible white mugs do not match the source mug, so the mug on the headphones’ right does not show that the source mug moved.
